title: list_screens result
description: What this machine will let the mixer capture, and how.

element.description: The GStreamer element that would be used, or empty when this machine has none.

screens.description: One entry per monitor the platform will name. Where the platform names none, one entry stands for the whole screen.

index.description: What to put in the `monitor` setting.

note.description: What an operator has to do on this platform before a capture will work: a permission to grant, a portal to go through, or nothing.
